L105: 【37†Show Champion】 Chart winners (2026)
L106: ---
L107: The Show Champion Chart is a 【38†record chart】 on the South Korean 【39†MBC M】 【40†television music program】 【37†Show Champion】. Every week, the show awards the best performing 【41†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.^{【42†[1]】}^{【43†[2]】} The show has been hosted by Nam Seong-mo of 【44†82Major】, Jeon Min-wook and Jang Yeo-jun of 【45†Close Your Eyes】 since May 2025.^{【46†[3]】}
